beats.say: Polygon says Sea of Thieves has an 88 percent user score from almost 150,000 reviews.
So what else is free to play right now?
IGN says Game Scope is a daily game that is free for everyone.
According to IGN, logged-in members can save their streak and compete for high scores.
IGN says the game will be in beta for a little while, while IGN Plus subscribers get archive access.
Which free game are you trying first?
